$comment: Input tuning. GamepadLayer.ts and DesktopLayer.ts contain no literals. Reference device is a ROG Ally, per DECISIONS.md D27.

gamepad.$comment_deadZone: Radial, applied to the stick vector rather than per axis. Per-axis dead zones make diagonals reachable at lower deflection than cardinals, which is why so many pads feel like they snap to eight directions.
gamepad.$comment_lookRate: Radians per second at full deflection. A stick is a RATE, unlike a mouse which is a delta, so GamepadLayer multiplies by the fixed timestep before writing into Intent.look. That keeps Intent's delta semantics and means nothing downstream knows a pad exists.
gamepad.$comment_lookCurve: Exponent on the normalised stick magnitude. Above 1 it buys fine aim near centre and full speed at the rim, which is the whole reason stick aiming is tolerable.
gamepad.$comment_sprint: Sprint is the left stick click, not a face button, so the thumb never leaves the stick.

mouse.$comment_dragFallback: Holding right mouse looks around without pointer lock. Pointer lock is still the good path, but it needs a click nobody tells you about, and a game that appears to have no camera control is worse than one with a slightly clumsy one.
